question: Who among the following sportspersons is one of the Arjuna Award 2021 winners?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nishad Kumar.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nishad Kumar**

 
 
• Nishad Kumar is an **Indian Paralympian high jumpe**r.
 
• He made his maiden Paralympic Games appearance in 2020 Tokyo representing India.
 
• He went on to claim the** silver medal** in the **men's high jump T47 **category with a new Asian record of 2.06m.
 
• He took up the sport of para-athletics in 2009. 
 
• In** November 2019**, he won the **bronze medal** in the men's T47 category at the 2019 World Para Athletics Championships.
 
• He also became the second Indian to win a medal at the 2020 Summer Paralympics after Bhavina Patel. 
 
• He was honored with the **Arjuna Award in 2021.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arjuna Award**

 
 
• **​**The Arjuna Award is officially known as **Arjuna Awards for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games.**
 
• It is the **second-highest** sporting honor of India.
 
• The award is named after Arjuna, one of the characters of the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata of ancient India.
 
• It is awarded annually by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• The nominations for the award are received from all government-recognized
 
 
• National Sports Federations
 
• Indian Olympic Association
 
• Sports Authority of India (SAI)
 
• Sports Promotion and Control Boards
